records.subject: Lapieite MCuPnQ3 (M=Ni, Pt, Pd; Pn=Sb, Bi; Q=S, Se)
records.object: Coexisting weak covalent, partially ionic and metavalent bonds
records.quote: We find that the lapieite group-rock-forming minerals buried deep in the earth-with the general formula MCuPnQ(3) (M = Ni, Pt, and Pd; Pn = Sb and Bi; and Q = S and Se) comprise the key metrics to become Thermoelectric Rockstars.
